Small signed 1930s Campbell vases at Gowans and Armitage mostly settle at $55 to $100, with $110 to $120 for better colour or form. eBay sold listings would add retail context but are not needed to set a hammer range.
viewing_check: Check height (small pieces under 10 cm sell at $35 to $55, 12 cm plus nearer $80 to $120), confirm the 1935 date and B.23 mark on the base, and look for hairline cracks, chips and glaze loss on the foot rim and rim. Glaze colour depth and amber drip richness lift price.
